name: ThreatDown
summary: ThreatDown is the business security line formerly sold as Malwarebytes for business. It comes in four bundles: Core, Advanced EDR, Elite MDR and Ultimate MDR Plus, billed per year with a 20% saving for a three-year term. The pricing page did not show dollar amounts when we read it, so a buyer should confirm the price in the vendor's store. The Nebula console manages endpoints.

facts.text: ThreatDown says Ransomware Rollback can restore files that were encrypted, detected or modified, up to 7 days after an attack.
The Core bundle lists threat monitoring and isolation plus automated endpoint remediation.
The pricing page offers a 20% saving on a three-year term and bills per year, but showed no dollar amounts when we read it.
